theorem_title: Exact indexing of local output records
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.OutputDecodeRecords.localRecords_getD {h i : ℕ} (hi : i < _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.OutputDecodeRecords.localCount h) :
    (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.GlobalKeyEnumeration.localRecords h).getD i (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.OutputDecodeRecords.blockDefault h) =
      (⟨i/_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.OutputDecodeRecords.layerCount h,(Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.OutputDecodeRecords.layerCount_pos h)).mpr hi⟩,
        _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.GlobalKeyEnumeration.layerRecord h ⟨i%_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.OutputDecodeRecords.layerCount h,Nat.mod_lt _ (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.OutputDecodeRecords.layerCount_pos h)⟩) := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Let $h,i\in\mathbb N$ with $i$ below the total local-record count, and let $M$ be the positive output-layer count for $h$. Entry $i$ of the ordered local-record list, read with its specified default, is exactly

$$\left(\left\lfloor i/M\right\rfloor,\ \operatorname{layerRecord}_h(i\bmod M)\right).$$

The quotient is interpreted as the schedule occurrence and the remainder as the layer index, with their finite-index bounds supplied by the stated range assumption.

This identifies physical record order with occurrence-and-mask decoding, retaining repeated values as distinct records.
